caption: Anxiety Relieve #wellness #mindfulness #usahealth #chinesemedicineworks #wellnessjourney
transcript: My friend, if your mind feels like this, here are three things you must do right now. First, take a piece of paper and write down every worry in your head. Do not fix them, just get them out onto the page. Second, one slow breath, in through the nose, a long, slow breath out through the mouth. The long breath out tells your body the danger has passed. Third, put your feet flat on the ground and feel it hold you. You are not in what might happen tomorrow, you are here. Do these three, my friend, whenever the mind races. Paper, breath, feet on the ground, follow me and come back tomorrow. We will quiet it together, a little each day.
